how_to_raise: Edit this file in the SAME pull request that grows the number, set limit to the new ceiling, update measured and measured_on, and justify the growth in the PR body (what was added, why it cannot be smaller, what it cost). A budget is raised by a reviewed decision, never to make a red run green.

binary_bytes.what: Size in bytes of the STRIPPED ARM plxnative binary that `make ipk FLAVOR=debug` stages into the package (ipkroot/data/usr/palm/applications/<appid>/plxnative), as the CI cross-build job builds it (default features, dev flavour). The shipped release binary is built with --no-default-features and is smaller; this is the number CI can measure on every PR.

packages_default.what: Third-party (registry/git) packages the app crate compiles for arm-unknown-linux-gnueabi with its DEFAULT features: normal + build dependencies, dev-dependencies excluded, workspace members excluded.

packages_no_default_features.what: The same count with --no-default-features, which is what every shipped binary is built with.

duplicate_versions_default.what: Crate names present in more than one version in the NORMAL-edge graph for the default feature set (the set `cargo tree -d --edges normal --target arm-unknown-linux-gnueabi` prints).

source_lines.what: Lines of Rust under rust-modules/src (every .rs file). Informational: exceeding it warns and never fails, because a growing feature is not a build-health defect by itself.
